limitations: P1 — Pinnedoptimizerstate-IDcollisionandguardloss — Counterevidence and alternatives: The LLM may never choose this pair in benchmark runs; the snapshot postdates the paper. Same-guard duplicates would be harmless, but no equality or implication test is performed. The semantic instruction could be good and the ID failure still occurs. Endpoint renumbering after collision cannot restore the lost distinction.

P2 — Algorithm2destination-listenerrouting — Counterevidence and alternatives: The current runtime retains local state_id and uses self.listeners[state_id] before recursion, with an explicit final/submission test. Thus the source provides a real counterexample to attributing this particular pseudocode bug to the pinned runtime. Marker parsing is a version-specific implementation distinction, not proof of benchmark failure.

P3 — Table5meansandTable6percentageerrors — Counterevidence and alternatives: Rounding each input by at most .005 cannot account for the first three discrepancies. An undisclosed weighting could change an average, so the conclusion is limited to failure to reconstruct the printed unweighted summaries. Main qualitative ordering, the approximate 97% comparison and displayed cost sums survive. Five performance tasks versus six cost tasks remains an unresolved population definition, not an invented sixth task.

P4 — DisplayedMLtraceandfinalreportmismatch — Counterevidence and alternatives: Additional executions or another evaluation split could exist outside this excerpt. Therefore the supported finding is an execution-to-narrative evidence gap in this example; it does not establish that every table score is false, that no additional models were ever run, or that the .8324 result is wrong.

assumptions: Operative assumptions: Five uniquely labeled input states 1..5; 1 initial and 5 final; ordinary 2 and 4 have different agents and matching flags. Suppose the LLM approves this pair and no later pair. This is allowed by the code gates; the claim is conditional, not a prediction of an actual LLM response. For guard loss assume two distinct conditions A and B on edges that become the same endpoint pair after a merge.

Operative assumptions: Distinct states A->B->C with distinct associated agents and L(A)={agent B}, L(B)={agent C}; output is generated at A and its verifier selects B. No aliasing between source and destination listener lists.

Operative assumptions: An unweighted mean of the five explicitly displayed dataset scores, as the report states. Original hidden raw precision or undisclosed weights cannot be reconstructed. Each displayed score is transcribed directly from the source image.

Operative assumptions: Assessment is about the evidence actually displayed in Appendix H.1, not completeness of unseen historical logs. The published narrative asserts title extraction and five trained model families, reports RF=.82 and best GBM=.83.
